research_rationale:
EO 12171 (signed November 19, 1979; 44 FR 66565) exempts listed agencies and subdivisions from the Federal Labor-Management Relations Program under 5 U.S.C. 7103(b): sections 1-101 and 1-102 make the national security determinations, section 1-2 lists excluded units (1-201 to 1-211) and section 1-3 lists one unit outside the United States (1-301). I read the complete held Federal Register original (6355 characters). I corrected the dossier inventory (16 clauses): the 54 dossier fragments of list items are merged into the section-level clauses that later orders amend (1-203 to 1-206 and 1-211 each with their lettered paragraphs), the missing section 1-204 heading is included, and the authority paragraph is added. Seventeen held later orders amend it (the OFR entry lists the same seventeen, from EO 12338 to EO 14343) and EO 13869 (2019) restates section 1-208; all eighteen are attached as later events. Orders that restate a whole section (EO 13480 for 1-203 and 1-210, EO 13760 for 1-204 to 1-208) carry a rewrite note, and each clause continues, amended, under the strike-and-insert ruling. Orders that only add new sections (1-212 onward, 1-4, 1-5) are attached to the authority paragraph clause. EO 12632 recites that EO 12171 remains in effect as amended. The held texts of EO 12338 to EO 14343 state no effective dates other than their signing, so signing dates are recorded; EO 14251 (March 27, 2025) and EO 14343 (August 28, 2025) are the latest. No held order revokes or supersedes EO 12171, and the three bounded searches record no revocation or supersession. All sixteen clauses are operative as amended, checked through 2026-10-14. Disclosed limits: the held texts do not show whether named organizations (for example the U.S. Customs Service entry replaced in 1989, or the Agency for International Development) still exist, and no source ends an entry for that reason, so the claim does not rest on any named unit; the sections 1-212 onward and 1-4 and 1-5 lists are additions and were not decided clause by clause because they are not original clauses.
